resale_co.name: Residential Certificate of Continued Occupancy (Certificate of Occupancy for resale), with a Zoning Permit
resale_co.issued_by: Town of Kearny Construction Code Enforcement Department (Construction Official/Zoning Officer)
resale_co.lead_time: No fixed number of days is published. The Town says to allow significant time before the closing date, last-minute inspections just before closing cannot be accommodated, and the checklist recommends the inspection as soon as the sales contract is signed.
requirements: Smoke alarms and CO alarms within 10 feet outside each bedroom; smoke alarms must be 10-year sealed units (CO alarms may be battery or plug-in); basement and first floor alarms usually on the ceiling within 3 feet of the stair opening
Portable fire extinguisher, 2A:10B:C, no more than 10 lb, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress (still listed on the Town package; see fire notes)
Cover plates on all switches, outlets and junction boxes
Handrail on any interior or exterior stair (including decks) with more than three risers, graspable and no wider than 2 5/8 inches
Pressure relief discharge pipe on heating units and water heaters, ending 6 to 8 inches above the floor
Faucets and toilets installed and working
Attached or built-in garage keeps its fire rating; door into the house fire rated and self-closing; holes from repairs patched
Sheds at least 3 feet from property lines and in good condition
Exit doors open from inside without keys; no double cylinder deadbolts
Gas piping strapped with shutoff valves near appliances, capped if an appliance was removed; no aluminum gas piping
No broken, cracked or missing glass
Guards/railings where the drop is 30 inches or more
Sidewalks, stairs, driveways and walkways in good repair
Yard clear of debris; grass, bushes and weeds cut
House numbers at least 4 inches high and visible from the street; roof, leaders, exterior walls, fences, sheds and interior surfaces in good repair

resale_co.how_to_apply: Fill out the Residential Certificate of Occupancy Package (Zoning Permit Application, Application for Zoning Certificate / Certificate of Continued Use Occupancy with the approximate closing date and purchaser details, the One and Two Family Smoke Detector and CO Detector application, and the other sheets in the package) and file it with the Construction Code Enforcement Department, Town Hall Annex, 410 Kearny Avenue, Kearny, NJ 07032, with a check or money order. Then call the front office at 201-955-7880 to schedule the inspection. Office hours Monday to Friday 8:00 am to 4:00 pm.

evidence.quote: Upon the transfer of title to any property located within the boundaries of the Town of Kearny, it shall be unlawful for any owner to occupy or permit the occupancy of that property without first obtaining a certificate of continued occupancy. resale_co.notes: The Town Code (section 38-9.3 b) requires a certificate of continued occupancy on every transfer of title except inheritance, and a zoning permit must be obtained first. The fee schedule comes from the Town's own PDF copy of Chapters 36 and 38 (created 2009); the current ecode360 code could not be opened, so confirm the $60/$80 amounts are still current. The live kearnynj.org site shows a bot check, so all Town pages and forms are cited from Internet Archive copies (original URLs: https://www.kearnynj.org/construction-code-enforcement/, https://www.kearnynj.org/forms/, https://www.kearnynj.org/wp-content/uploads/2024/02/Residential-CO.pdf, https://www.kearnynj.org/wp-content/uploads/2018/10/Land-Use-Regualtion-Chapter-36-38.pdf, https://www.kearnynj.org/wp-content/uploads/2023/08/Zoning-Permit-2023.pdf). The 2024 package is a scan and was read page by page. The package also has a lead-based paint form that applies only to rental properties built before 1978, and a COVID-era inspection health survey. The contact name and extension come from the December 2024 capture of the department page.

requirements: Smoke alarms for resales must be 10-year sealed battery units (Town sheet says required as of January 22, 2019); A/C powered or interconnected alarms in homes built after January 1977 must be kept working
Smoke alarm on each level and outside each sleeping area within 10 feet; CO alarm outside each sleeping area within 10 feet (battery, hard-wired or plug-in, UL 2034, 85 dBA)

The Town's February 2024 package still requires a 2A:10B:C portable fire extinguisher, 10 lb or less, mounted within 10 feet of the kitchen in the path of egress and no higher than 5 feet (a 1A:10B:C unit is shown as not acceptable). The state removed the extinguisher from its requirement in February 2025 (P.L.2025, c.19); no newer Town form was found.

fire_cert.notes: The Kearny Fire Department is the Uniform Fire Code enforcing agency (registry code F; Fire Official Daniel Neves, (201) 991-1402, dneves@kearnynj.org per the state directory), but for 1-2 family sales the Town Code and the state directory both put the smoke/CO certificate with the Construction Code office (the state directory lists "Kearny Constr Code", 410 Kearny Av, (201) 955-7884 as the smoke detector compliance contact). There is no separate smoke certificate fee for 1-2 family homes: it is included in the $60/$80 certificate of continued occupancy fee. The fire department page on kearnynj.org lists only Chief Joseph P. Mastandrea (201-991-1402) and has no resale information.

other_items.label: Zoning Permit first
other_items.detail: A zoning permit ($25, check or money order, no cash) must be obtained before the certificate of continued occupancy is issued.

other_items.label: Office checks at filing
other_items.detail: The Application for Zoning Certificate has office-use lines for open permits, monetary penalties, legal use, fire department smoke detector sign-off, state housing violations and state housing registration number.

other_items.label: Lead-based paint (rentals only)
other_items.detail: A lead-based paint form in the package applies only if the dwelling is a rental property built before 1978; the Town does not do lead testing.
